status: pending admission; full native text implemented, starter gates remain closed
implementation: Unique named Executor site may deploy without the hull; dynamic relation and ordinary hull-departure persistence follow the existing named ship-site provider.

An active Imperial leader at the station adds one Executor power for each named Executor site on table. Nonunique Launch Bay is not a named Executor site; canceling a leader's game text preserves its leader characteristic.
When Light controls the station during Dark's move phase, only Light can move Executor. This belongs to the Light side of the printed text and does not change the hull or crew owner.

Movement retains normal piloting, navigation, range, cost, barrier and regular-move requirements. Light pays its own Force. Exact source-site identity and active permission are rechecked during responses.
The same exclusive movement helper applies to parent-owned ship-docking integration. Moving a character to or from Executor does not move Executor and does not inherit this restriction.
